claims.statement: For every N>=2 and every s in Z/NZ, n=ceil(log2 N), the single STREAMFIXED13229 algorithm and configuration fully specified in proof.md and odd_partition.md (fixed k=10000000000000001, finite branch n<2^512, otherwise the exact integer profile, bounded READY/PENDING controller, capped exact dyadic odd-partition circuit, measured collimation tree and physical full-secret odd/two-adic decoders) recovers the entire s with unconditional probability at least 1-2^-8 from independent ideal coset copies. Jointly on EVERY execution branch, including all failures, discards and aborts, its total charged sequential work T is O(2^((13229/10000) sqrt n)), with an absolute outside constant. Every allocated bit/qubit and compiler/address cost is counted; the huge fixed circuit constant and finite cutoff are disclosed. The chosen uniform envelope has exact growth index 1/2. The complete self-contained mathematical argument is in the two evidence files; no predecessor verdict or artifact-identity claim is a premise.
